# Betaflight OSD Fonts

> Betaflight fonts for design: the ten stock Betaflight OSD fonts that come with Betaflight Configurator (the on-screen display type FPV drone pilots see in their goggles), converted for use outside the goggles: installable OTF and TTF, web WOFF and WOFF2, and all 256 characters of each font as transparent PNG files. Free and open source under GPL 3.0.

- They are colour (COLR) fonts: every white glyph carries its own black outline, so text stays readable over video with no layer effects. Apps without colour font support, such as Figma, get two flat families, `Shadow` and `Fill`, to stack instead.
- Full Cyrillic, Greek, accented Latin, typographic punctuation, maths, currency and box drawing were drawn for every font from its own shapes. The source fonts only have ASCII and icons.
- The fonts are all capitals: lowercase types as capitals.
- The OSD icons (arrows, battery, RSSI, GPS, flight modes, logo tiles) sit at `U+E000 + index`, and also type by name as OpenType ligatures, e.g. `:battery:`, `:home:`, `:arrow_n:`.
- The fonts: extra_large, clarity, bold, impact, vision, betaflight, impact_mini, default, large, digital.
- Typical uses: FPV video thumbnails, stream overlays, video titles, and designs that should look like a real drone OSD.

## Docs

- [The landing page as Markdown]({{SITE}}/index.md): what is in the fonts, every font with its look, file layout, direct download URLs, typing and app support
- [Symbol reference]({{RAW}}/docs/SYMBOLS.md): every OSD icon with its index, codepoint and ligature name
- [README]({{RAW}}/README.md): overview of the fonts, sets and downloads
- [Developer docs]({{RAW}}/docs/DEVELOPERS.md): how `bf2font.py` converts a MAX7456 `.mcm` font, and how to convert your own

## Downloads

- [All fonts, all formats (.zip)]({{REPO}}/archive/refs/heads/main.zip): the whole repository, `output/<font>/` holds each font
- [Original .mcm fonts]({{REPO}}/tree/main/original_fonts): the ten stock fonts exactly as Betaflight Configurator ships them, one `<font>.mcm` each, for the font manager and the flight controller; direct file at `{{RAW}}/original_fonts/<font>.mcm`
- [Character index for clarity (JSON)]({{RAW}}/output/clarity/clarity.json): every character, set and symbol with its codepoint; each font has the same file at `output/<font>/<font>.json`
- [Character sheet for clarity (PNG)]({{RAW}}/output/clarity/clarity_sheet.png): all 256 characters as one 16×16 sheet
